summary: A short exchange about whether someone was against Dixieland.

blocks.x: This isn't the galloping gourmet, folks. This is close-up. We're talking with Pete Fountain and Eddie Miller. Hello. Hello. I like Pete Fountain. Yes, sir. Here he is.
Now Hoyt. Now Hoyt was against Dixieland.
Oh, I don't think he said it was against Dixieland.
